mapper.select: SELECT count(1) FROM tb_user_article_history WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT h.id, h.article_id AS articleId, a.article_title AS articleTitle, a.article_cover AS articleCover, h.progress_percent AS progressPercent, h.last_read_time AS lastReadTime FROM tb_user_article_history h JOIN tb_article a ON h.article_id = a.id WHERE h.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY h.last_read_time DESC LIMIT #{limitCurrent}, #{size}
